decisions.statement: The provider a gateway falls back to is DeepSeek.
The account the fallback is sent under is the one held with that provider.
The base is read off the provider's page and the key off the account's sops file.
A fallback the root files no account for is answered as none.
A fallback whose account holds no key is answered as none.
The model a fallback asks for is read off the provider's page.
A body is rewritten to ask for that model rather than the model the caller named.
A provider stating no model of its own is asked for what the caller named.
A body nothing here can rewrite is sent as that body came.
A fallback read once is held for the life of the reader.
A fallback answered as none is read again on the next call.
The repository root reaches every reader here as a parameter.
The reader of an account's secrets reaches this module as a parameter.
No key value reaches a log here.
A key rotated after the first read is not picked up until the gateway restarts.

definition: the base, key and model a gateway sends a provider a request with
